# 2 Clement — Chapter 10 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 10
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Brothers, let us obey the will of the Father who called us, so that we may truly live. Let us pursue what is right with greater urgency, stripping away every destructive habit — clearing the ground, as it were, for a life of goodness — so that we do not suffer terrible consequences for ignoring the Lord's commands.
2. The Lord has said: "Even if you were pressed against my chest — if you did not keep my commandments, I would throw you out and say: Get away from me. I do not know you or where you come from, you who practice lawlessness."
3. Brothers, let us leave behind our attachment to this world. Let us do the will of the one who called us and not be afraid to die.
4. The Lord said: "You will be like lambs in the midst of wolves."
5. Peter said to him: "But what if the wolves tear the lambs apart?"
6. Jesus replied: "Once lambs are dead, they need not fear wolves. And you — stop fearing those who can only kill the body and do nothing more. Fear the one who, after you die, has the power to throw you into the fire of Gehenna. That power belongs to him alone."
